cloudgate_fixture.how: Recorded by `tofu show -json` from a real plan in the live Google Cloud project on 2026-11-06 (a walk by hand, step 10; OpenTofu 1.13.1, hashicorp/google 8.8.0), then rewritten to the stored files' sample ids (cloud_1, env_1 and the Service and state ids this file stored before, project example-project-123 / 123456789012, region europe-west1, the image cloudgate-stand-in-new-image) and with every secret value masked (variable values, the default certificate and its key). A command-only change to a made Cron service (`stuck`'s sleep to /bin/sleep): its job updated in place, the container's command the only change.
